cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This café chair wobbles. Take the chairs apart; let's use the fault-finding method I taught you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tested them. It's only this chair, on this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally, a proper diagnosis. Lift the floorboards; we'll see what else your teacher has saved you from missing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then close for renovations. With the floor out, we'll move the counter and fix the queue. Write that on the sign, not 'Broken chair.' I taught you to look past the first fault.
